All work is complete and verified. Final summary of the implementation:

## `/workspace/submission/main.py` (21,288 bytes, regular file, stdlib-only)

**Framing & strict validation** — per-line JSON with duplicate-key rejection (`object_pairs_hook`), rejection of floats/`NaN`/`Infinity`/booleans-for-integers, ID/hex/kinds regexes, all documented cardinality and range limits (16 MiB lines, 1..64 nodes, 0..512 caps, 2..9 distinct path nodes, 8≤H≤256, exactly one Q/T, ≥1 K, `4+#D<H`, labels 16..1048575, ≤20000 events, ≤2 MiB packet bytes, ≤22 plan flows, ≤256 runs, ≤1e9 total count, ≤65536 offer header bytes). Any violation → exactly `{"error":"input"}`, without affecting other lines.

**Replay** — table/entry accounting with the documented `put` priority (idempotent → busy → full → install, no slot for overwrites), readiness-gated `enable`, `disable`/`reset` drain semantics, stale entries reported in `tables` sorted by (node,label). Packet path: classification order (disabled → mismatch → qos → compressed), exact MPLS word `(label<<12)|(Q<<9)|(1<<8)|ttl` with per-hop label swap and residue, TTL=0 pre-drop, switch drop at TTL≤1 (`L = min(N, TTL)`), reconstruction with K-from-template / D-from-residue / Z-zero / Q-from-TC / T-final-TTL (big-int masked, C-speed), IP fallback header splicing, and exact `byte_hops`.

**Plan** — per-flow benefit from run-wise warmup arithmetic; `{"infeasible":true}` when pinned alone exceed capacity; safe reductions (drop unfit/zero-benefit, non-binding and dominance-implied constraints, force unconstrained flows) then exact lexicographic optimisation via the injective transform `benefit·(n+1)−1`, solved by take-first branch & bound with a per-node top-k bound (early-exit) and a verified memoised-DP fallback.

**Verification performed**: public checks pass; 6 hand-computed scenario tests; 79 invalid-input tests; thousands of random replays cross-checked against an independent naive simulator (all modes/reasons/statuses, drops, H up to 256, 9-hop paths); plan optimality proven against exhaustive brute force for n≤17 across 7 adversarial families plus pinned/warmup variants, and B&B↔DP agreement at n=22; ~1700 timing configurations with worst-case 0.17 s, and a 4 MiB request emitting 40 MiB in 0.4 s.
